pkgmetadata.longdescription:
AMD/Xilinx "Peano" is an LLVM/clang/lld fork that adds the AI Engine (AIE) backend targets used by AMD Ryzen AI / XDNA NPUs: aie, aie2 (XDNA1 Phoenix/Hawk), aie2p (XDNA2 Strix Halo) and aie2ps. It is the chess-free backend, so no proprietary xchesscc / Vitis toolchain is required to compile kernels for AIE2/AIE2P. It is the low-level compiler that dev-util/mlir-aie (IRON) drives to build NPU kernels.
This ebuild repackages the upstream prebuilt py3-none wheel (a bundle of native binaries); upstream ships no source releases or stable tags. The version is pinned to the exact Peano build that the matching mlir-aie release is CI-tested against.
